summary.text: Rick Shealy is the Republican candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Michanna Tate (D) and Henry Jones (United Citizens Party) are also on the ballot and there is no incumbent.
He won the June 9, 2026 Republican primary, defeating incumbent Luke Rankin, 60.1% to 39.9%.
